integrity: The asserted infinite-family result is proved analytically; rational finite enumeration serves as a cross-check and never substitutes for the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Uniform spanning trees of labelled complete bipartite graphs only; first-coordinate Walsh band; fixed vertex count with varying edge counts. General transfer-current/forest probabilities are previously known. Absolute novelty and independent validation not certified.
title: The optimal bipartite shape for one-edge Walsh sampling on uniform spanning trees
